reviewer: Codex war owner, actual six images inspected

views.name: hull_rig
findings: Two principal masts carry stacked square courses, with the fore-and-aft sail directly on the mainmast and no separate Snow pole.
The visible broadside has one gun row; the ochre hull, pale panelled canvas, open central hatch and distinct deck fittings remain readable in the whole-ship field.
views.scope: Whole actual GLB with all visible hull, rig and sails.

views.name: deck_closeup
findings: The coaming surrounds a real opening through individual planks, and a stair flight with treads, stringers and side rails descends below the main deck.
At the matched 4.5 m reference field, longitudinal wood grain and staggered plank joints remain readable; the framed stair flight adds distinct joinery beyond the reference ladder rungs.
views.scope: Actual deck and fitting close-up at a fixed 4.5 metre physical field; rig hidden for visibility.

views.name: hold_interior
findings: The intact view retains curved ribs, longitudinal ceiling planks, overhead beams, a jointed planked sole and the mast seated in its timber step.
Fitted storage and a lantern sit to the sides while an exposed working strip remains beside the mast; this has substantially more visible internal structure than the smooth-walled reference hold.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: hold_cutaway
findings: The declared hidden outer hull and upper timbers expose a continuous sequence of curved frames and longitudinal stringers around the lower hull.

Access flights and retained stores remain identifiable within the framing; guns and rig fittings appear exposed because their named surrounding covers are temporarily hidden in this supplementary view.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.

views.name: cabin_interior
findings: The intact cabin shows a full table, separate bench and metal-framed lantern, with actual closed legs and supports seated on the planked floor.
The doorway, side ribs and overhead beams remain present; readable timber grain and fitted joinery add detail at the same 20 mm lens and eye height as the reference cabin.
views.scope: Camera inside the actual enclosed GLB room; auxiliary camera fill reveals timber and furniture.

views.name: cabin_cutaway
findings: A long mattress on a raised timber berth and a separate bedside cabinet are visible beside the retained aft planked sole.
The supplementary cutaway exposes the cabin floor edge, curved stern framing and adjacent gun stations after its named enclosing timbers are hidden; the delivered model is unchanged.
views.scope: Read-only cutaway: named outer hull, upper deck timbers and bulkheads temporarily hidden; delivered GLB unchanged.

limitations: Static geometry and PBR inspection only; gameplay controllers and historical exactness are not certified.
The 640 by 512, twelve-sample images soften tiny bolts, deadeye bores and rope fibres in the whole-ship field; numerical fitting and clearance checks remain separate.
The wood uses repeating authored grain maps; the review assesses readable physical grain and joinery, without certifying exact historical timber species or unique wear.
The intact hold has a dark distant end, and the berth is outside the intact cabin camera field; the separate declared cutaways reveal those structural and furnishing details.
instructions: Inspect every listed actual image and the matched old Brig reference views. Add at least two concrete observations per view. Set decision PASS only after inspection. A cutaway remains supplementary to the separate intact interior view.
reference_comparison: Reference deck field: 4.5 m orthographic, matched view direction and area lighting.
Reference enclosed rooms: 20 mm lens, camera 1.23 m above sole, matched auxiliary area lighting.
The new hatch, hull framing, deck seams, room joinery and furnished berth are visibly at least as detailed as the reviewed reference at those disclosed scales.
